%% ---- JCST-like float captions ---------------------------------------------
\DeclareCaptionLabelFormat{jcstfig}{\textbf{#1#2}}
\DeclareCaptionLabelFormat{jcsttab}{#1~#2}
\captionsetup[figure]{labelformat=jcstfig,labelsep=period,font=small,
                      justification=raggedright,singlelinecheck=false,
                      aboveskip=5pt,belowskip=0pt}
\captionsetup[table]{labelformat=jcsttab,labelsep=period,font=small,
                     justification=centering,singlelinecheck=false,
                     aboveskip=2pt,belowskip=3pt}
\renewcommand{\figurename}{Fig.}
\renewcommand{\tablename}{Table}

%% ---- JCST-like running heads ----------------------------------------------
\pagestyle{fancy}
\fancyhf{}
\renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0pt}
\fancyhead[LE]{\footnotesize\thepage\hspace{2em}J. Comput. Sci. \& Technol.}
\fancyhead[RO]{\footnotesize Leakage-Free Fine-Grained Fake News
               Detection\hspace{2em}\thepage}
\fancypagestyle{firstpage}{%
  \fancyhf{}%
  \renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0pt}%
  \fancyfoot[L]{\footnotesize Regular Paper}%
}

%% ---- theorem-like environments (JCST numbers them with Arabic numerals) ----
\newtheorem{definition}{Definition}
\newtheorem{proposition}{Proposition}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}

%% ---- spacing and lists -----------------------------------------------------
\setlength{\parindent}{1.1em}
\setlist[itemize]{leftmargin=1.2em,itemsep=1pt,topsep=2pt,parsep=0pt}
\setlist[enumerate]{leftmargin=1.5em,itemsep=1pt,topsep=2pt,parsep=0pt}
\renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.08}
\setlength{\tabcolsep}{4pt}

%% ---- float placement (this paper is float-heavy) ---------------------------
\setcounter{topnumber}{3}
\setcounter{bottomnumber}{2}
\setcounter{totalnumber}{5}
\renewcommand{\topfraction}{0.92}
\renewcommand{\bottomfraction}{0.7}
\renewcommand{\textfraction}{0.06}
\renewcommand{\floatpagefraction}{0.7}
\extrafloats{64}

\newcommand{\bs}[1]{\boldsymbol{#1}}
\newcommand{\best}[1]{\textbf{#1}}

%% ---- figure widths, so body.tex can be shared with the review copy ---------
\newcommand{\figfull}{\linewidth}        % full column
\newcommand{\figmed}{0.95\linewidth}     % heatmaps
\newcommand{\fignarrow}{0.85\linewidth}  % tall pipeline diagram
\newcommand{\figwide}{0.94\textwidth}    % the two figure* floats
\hyphenation{mis-in-for-ma-tion clas-si-fi-ca-tion PolitiFact}
%% keep inter-paragraph glue tight rather than stretching columns to the foot
\raggedbottom
